description: B5 SHED SHEATHED (SHEATHING; docs/reference-parts/buildings.md B5 and B2, docs/BACKLOG.md SHEATHING): one loft.floor 1.1.0 feature at its defaults (B5's floor with a 23/32 plywood subfloor), then B2's four loft.wall 1.2.0 walls with 7/16 OSB exterior sheathing (corners lapped) and B2's hosted door and window, standing on the subfloor (base elevation 8.75 + 23/32 = 9.46875 in). model.json is EXACTLY the five expansions with their member materials; members.json is each body's member metadata (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_sheathing.py pins both).
derivation: ANALYTIC, in exact rationals, from members typed by hand from buildings.md, independent of the plugin (the script is services/geometry/tests/test_sheathing_b5.py's spec): B5's 16 floor boxes; 6 subfloor boxes Z 8.75..9.46875 (X 0..96, 96..144 at Y 0..48 and 96..120; X 0..48, 48..144 at Y 48..96); B2's 64 door-and-window framing boxes (28 942.125 in^3) raised 9.46875; and 12 OSB panels 7/16 thick outside each wall's exterior face, Z 9.46875..106.59375, 48 in from each wall's start: front (Y -7/16..0) X 96..144, 48..96 less the door X 53..91 x Z 0..82.5 above the base (a U, 8 corners), 0..48; back (Y 120..120 7/16) X 0..48, 48..96, 96..144; left (X -7/16..0) Y 3.5..51.5, 51.5..99.5, 99.5..116.5; right (X 144..144 7/16) Y 68.5..116.5 less the window Y 68.5..72.25 x Z 46..82.5, 20.5..68.5 less Y 47.75..68.5, 3.5..20.5; and 4 CORNER RIPS (SHEATHING review, WALL-SHEATHING-CORNER) in the side walls' planes lapping over the front and back walls' end grain and OSB edge, 3.5 + 7/16 = 3.9375 wide, full height: X -7/16..0 and 144..144 7/16, each at Y -7/16..3.5 and 116.5..120 7/16.
surface_area = 7 065 707/32 in^2 = 142453485.25375 mm^2 (boxes 2(ab + bc + ca); a panel 2 x face area + perimeter x 7/16).

topology: 99 boxes (6 faces, 12 edges) and 3 notched panels (8 corners: 10 faces, 24 edges) = 624 faces, 1260 edges, 102 shells. MESH: a box 24 vertices and 12 triangles, a notched panel 48 and 28: 2520 vertices, 1272 triangles.

Interference none: the subfloor's top (Z 9.46875) only touches the bottom plates, each panel's inner face only touches its wall's framing, and each corner rip only touches the end it covers and its neighbours' edges (test_sheathing_b5.py probes every pair).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill): the bounds are ABSOLUTE and the part is ~1.3e9 mm^3, so the double-precision sum of its 102 bodies carries round-off near the ULP of the sum (~2.4e-7): measured +7.0e-07 mm^3 on the volume, -5e-08 mm^2 on the area, 1.4e-12 mm on the centroid, +8e-10 g on the mass. 2e-6 is 2.9x that and ~1.5e-15 relative, the B5 goldens' bound; a panel 0.001 in too wide adds 7 200 mm^3 to the volume, so it fails by nine orders.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: Measured 2026-10-17: the STEP round trip re-sums the 98 re-imported solids in another order and moves the VOLUME by +1.9e-06 mm^3 (1.4e-15 relative, 8 ULPs of the sum) and the AREA by under 2e-6 mm^2, above ROUNDTRIP_TOL (1e-7 absolute). 5e-6 is 2.6x the volume's drift; the cause is the other B5 goldens' (3e-6 over 64 bodies). It applies to volume and area only, centroid and bounds keep ROUNDTRIP_TOL.
